# relegate

> Send or commit to an inferior place, rank, condition, etc.; exile, banish; assign (a task) to someone else

> consign to a place or position of insignificance, lower rank, or inferiority


## Example

- *When Dexter was unable to fulfill his basic duties, instead of firing him, the boss relegated him to kitchen cleanup.*
